title: Scene
description: starting-soon, be-right-back or ending. Sets the default headline, subline, countdown label and map label. Changing it restarts the countdown.

title: Headline
description: Big title text. Leave empty for the scene's default (Starting soon / Be right back / Thanks for watching).

title: Subline
description: Line under the headline. Leave empty for the scene's default; enter a single - to hide it.

title: Countdown / minutes
description: Length of the countdown, started when the source loads (or when this or the scene changes). 0 hides the countdown. Up to 600.

title: Show map
description: Card with the map currently selected or played in osu!, with its background.

title: Show session
description: Plays and playtime of this osu! session, from vosu.

title: Backdrop
description: map = the selected map's background, dimmed. graphite = plain graphite sheet. transparent = nothing behind the text, for your own scene background (then Backing applies).

title: Motion
description: full = the sheet enters, countdown digits roll, the map fades in on a map change, the countdown's colon lifts on the selected map's beat while its music plays and the map backdrop breathes through kiai sections. reduced = the entrance, digit roll and map fade only; no beat or kiai motion. off = everything instant.

title: Backing
description: Only with Backdrop = transparent (map and graphite already put a dark field under the text). scrim = a dark field across the sheet with soft edges that keeps small text readable on a bright background. panel = a solid graphite sheet. none = text straight on your background with a contrast shadow; only for a dark or dimmed background.

title: Map colour
description: Colour the map's identity (the title block's top rule and the star) from the map's background. Off = neutral. The countdown and the sheet's marks stay 18-LAB amber either way.
